learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully completed the "Sustainability Management" module expand their understanding of the fundamentals of sustainability and its practical application in various areas. They are familiar with definitions and the priority model of sustainability as well as the UN Sustainable Development Goals and the European Green Deal. Through technical fundamentals such as digitalization, simulation technology, and product development, they can develop and implement sustainable solutions. In addition, they understand business aspects such as corporate key figures, KPIs, and project management fundamentals such as objectives and risk management. Furthermore, they can understand and classify the Carbon Management System and Corporate Carbon Footprints.

Students who have completed the "Sustainability Management" module possess a comprehensive understanding of the fundamentals of sustainability and their practical application in various contexts. They understand business concepts such as corporate key figures and KPIs and can apply them to sustainable corporate strategies. Project management fundamentals such as objectives and risk management, as well as the development of a roadmap, support them in implementing sustainability strategies. Through their understanding of the Carbon Management System and Corporate Carbon Footprints, they are able to plan and monitor sustainability measures.

assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam (Klausur), the duration of which is specified in the valid study regulations. The ungraded examination is experimental work, consisting of approximately 5 experiments, each lasting 90 minutes.
